In celebration of Jungkook’s birthday, we dedicated our efforts to projects that go beyond a single day of festivity—initiatives that truly touch lives and create ripples of change. ✨
#2025JungkookBirthdayProjects

Euphoria of Life: Jungkook Blood Drive🩸 The blood drive began with a wonderful morning: 11 generous individuals came forward, 9 of whom successfully donated. Later in the day, however, a thunderstorm brought heavy rain and flooding in the area, which may have prevented other registered donors from attending. Yet despite the weather, the spirit of giving was alive—those who came not only donated but also expressed their hope that this project continues yearly, so that more can join in the future.

In total, 9 bags of blood were collected—enough to help save up to 27 lives. 
These donations were turned over to the Philippine Blood Center, which supplies blood to hospitals across Metro Manila and provincial areas, ensuring that countless patients and families benefit from this meaningful act.

All of this was done in honor of Jungkook—whose compassion continues to inspire us to give, to help, and to touch lives in ways that matter. 

Seats for Dreamers Project 🪑 We are honored to have donated 120 brand-new armchairs to Amparo High School. For years, students endured broken chairs, many without armrests, often forced to write on their laps just to keep up with lessons. The first 60 chairs have already been delivered and are now in use in classrooms; the remaining batch is in production and will arrive in the first week of September.

The gratitude expressed by the students and their parents was deeply moving—they even prepared a heartfelt video to thank and greet Jungkook for this meaningful gift. This project is not just about providing chairs, but about creating a better learning environment where dreams can take root. These armchairs will serve not only the students of today but also generations to come, a lasting reminder that even small acts of kindness can open doors for countless young dreamers.

We sincerely thank our generous sponsors, the Philippine Blood Center, the selfless blood donors, and our dedicated team, Jungkook_Scener fanbase, for making these projects possible. 🙏🏻

🌟 Inspired by Jungkook’s compassion, we are reminded that the best way to honor someone is to embody the values they represent. May we continue to celebrate him by giving hope, creating opportunities, and spreading love—one dream at a time. ❤️

#ThereIsMagicInJKDay
#BillionWishesForJK
#HigherWithJungkook
#JKYouAreThatSomebody
#ForeverGoldenJungkook
#AlwaysWithJungkook
#ShineOnUsJungkook
#IllBeRightThereJK

HAPPY JK DAY
#HappyBirthdayJungkook

🚦Attention all traffic warriors! Ready to see billboard stars while stuck in rush hour? Amigas' are kicking of our Minamahal Project with a static billboard that's about to become your new favorite sight on the way to work! 🌟

Get ready to gaze up and say, "Is that Minamahal I see?" as you cross the Pasig River via C5 Road! A month long display of our billboard is taking over the C5 Road, and trust us—it's way more exciting than staring at brake lights! 🙌✨ So while you're stuck in traffic, why not feast your eyes on the official poster of Minamahal?

📍 Location: Lot 3, Blk. 10 Napindan Riverside, West Rembo, Makati City. It’s the perfect pit stop for both drivers and pedestrians!

Get ready to be "that person" who points out the billboard to your friends while they’re busy scrolling through their phones. Let's make it big Keepers!

#AshDres #AshDresVille | #AshtineOlviga #AndresMuhlach
